assumptions: Paper-guided unofficial implementation; official MSTMN code and weights were not identified.
Synthetic-first training on CRVD scene 1-6; this sampling choice is not verified MSTMN source behavior.
25 frames use random-phase/direction ping-pong of seven captured frames, without endpoint duplication.
Packed RGBG crop128 starts at even packed coordinates; no spatial augmentation.
Synthetic noise uses CRVD author DN coefficients, DN clipping and uint16 truncation; GT float DN is preserved.
First restoration and all three initial memory slots use the first noisy frame.
Full 25-frame BPTT; one optimizer update per effective batch16; no gradient clipping.
Learning-rate thresholds are one-based: update15000 uses0.0005 and update40000 uses0.0001.
Frozen BasicSR Sintel SPyNet with explicit RAW-to-RGB bridge is a reproduction choice.
CUDA grid_sample backward may be nondeterministic even with fixed seeds; bitwise GPU repeatability is not claimed.
No validation or tuning on CRVD test scenes occurs in this training engine.

evidence.paper: MSTMN IV-A, PDFp8/printed5817: crop128 packed, sequence25, batch16, Adam,120000 iterations and learning-rate milestones.
